purpose: WP6.1 target-free source-observation dictionary for V2ShotContext; no preprocessing is fitted and no model is evaluated.
admission_disclaimer: Statuses describe source-observation readiness only. They do not admit a feature or bundle into a model; bundle admission and evaluation are WP6.2+ work.

features.name: distance_to_goal
features.derivation: reuse WP2.2 distance_to_goal on recorded shot location

features.name: visible_goal_angle
features.derivation: reuse WP2.2 visible_goal_angle on recorded shot location

features.name: body_part
features.derivation: preserve source category

features.name: technique
features.derivation: preserve source category

features.name: play_pattern
features.derivation: preserve source category

features.name: first_time
features.derivation: preserve true, false, and absent distinctly

features.name: under_pressure
features.derivation: preserve true, false, and absent distinctly

features.name: distance_spline_basis
features.derivation: future fold-fitted cubic spline; no fitting in WP6.1

features.name: angle_spline_basis
features.derivation: future fold-fitted cubic spline; no fitting in WP6.1

features.name: distance_angle_interaction
features.derivation: predeclared bounded interaction or two-dimensional basis; configuration remains to be normalized

features.name: shot_type
features.derivation: preserve source category

features.name: pre_shot_score_differential
features.football_meaning: shooting side score minus opponent score before the shot
features.derivation: accumulate earlier recorded scoring events in the same match
features.missingness: must resolve or fail; never use final match scores

features.name: match_clock
features.derivation: preserve period and recorded clock; extra-time semantics explicit
features.leakage_risk: must not derive final match state

features.name: possession_duration
features.football_meaning: elapsed time since first recorded possession event
features.derivation: shot timestamp minus first same-possession timestamp when both resolve
features.missingness: missing possession or timestamp remains missing

features.name: possession_action_count
features.football_meaning: number of earlier recorded possession actions
features.derivation: count earlier same-possession events

features.name: preceding_event_type
features.football_meaning: type of immediately preceding recorded possession event
features.derivation: select prior same-possession event by source order
features.missingness: first or unresolved possession event remains missing

features.name: preceding_event_displacement
features.football_meaning: movement from preceding event to shot
features.derivation: coordinate delta and distance when both recorded locations exist

features.name: preceding_event_end_zone
features.football_meaning: coarse end zone of preceding event
features.derivation: no universal typed event-end coordinate exists

features.name: pass_carry_dribble_context
features.derivation: classify only typed verified Pass, Carry, or Dribble facts
features.missingness: other or unverified context remains missing

features.name: set_piece_context
features.derivation: preserve source categories; do not infer restart history
features.serving_requirement: recorded play pattern and shot type

features.name: key_pass_attributes
features.football_meaning: verified attributes of recorded key pass
features.derivation: resolve same-match reference and expose only verified typed attributes
features.missingness: absent reference remains missing; unresolved required reference fails

features.name: goalkeeper_displacement
features.football_meaning: recorded goalkeeper displacement from goal reference
features.derivation: identify only source-labelled goalkeeper and calculate from recorded location
features.missingness: missing frame or unidentified goalkeeper remains missing
features.leakage_risk: embedded frame only; no inferred goalkeeper

features.name: goalkeeper_distance_to_shot_goal_line
features.football_meaning: goalkeeper position relative to shot and goal line
features.derivation: source-verified coordinate calculation only
features.missingness: missing frame or unidentified goalkeeper remains missing
features.leakage_risk: embedded frame only; no inferred position

features.name: nearest_defender_distance
features.football_meaning: closest recorded opposing actor to shot
features.derivation: minimum distance among source-labelled non-teammates with locations
features.missingness: missing or unusable frame remains missing
features.leakage_risk: embedded frame only; no inferred actors

features.name: opponents_within_fixed_radii
features.football_meaning: recorded opponents near shot at declared radii
features.derivation: count source-labelled non-teammates within future fixed radii
features.missingness: missing or unusable frame remains missing
features.leakage_risk: radii must be predeclared; no inferred actors

features.name: defenders_inside_visible_goal_cone
features.football_meaning: recorded opposing actors inside visible goal cone
features.derivation: apply source-verified coordinate geometry to recorded actors
features.missingness: missing or unusable frame remains missing
features.leakage_risk: coordinate transform and cone semantics require verification

features.name: local_obstruction_density
features.football_meaning: bounded local recorded-actor density near shot path
features.derivation: requires predeclared source-verified bounded summary
features.missingness: missing or unusable frame remains missing
features.leakage_risk: no inferred actors or unverified transform
